summary: The 'CriminalRecordsCheck' module is a user control component within a web application (likely ASP.NET) that facilitates management and tracking of criminal record checks on student enrollments. It provides an interactive grid for reviewing, updating, and maintaining CRC status and related actions for students enrolled in specified cohort, term, and course contexts. The control supports advanced filtering, paging, sorting, actions (such as waiving, editing, deleting, reactivating), email functionality, and business logic for access and status updates.
purpose: To provide system administrators and authorized users with a workflow-driven interface for managing student criminal record check statuses, capturing relevant data, maintaining audit trails, enforcing business rules, and supporting communication related to criminal records within enrollment processes.

workflows.name: View and Manage CRC Status
steps: User accesses CriminalRecordsCheck control for a specified cohort, term, and course.
Grid displays student enrollment records with CRC status and related fields.
User applies filters (grad, inactive, waived, section, action, search keyword, campus, comment).
Grid supports paging, sorting, and toggling record visibility.
User can edit CRC status for a student (single or batch edit).
Editing launches modal popup for CRC status update.
User selects CRC status, enters CRC status date and notes.
Save action triggers update of student CRC details, UI refreshes grid.
User can waive/unwaive CRC requirement for a student.
Delete/reactivate actions available based on graduation/inactive status and permissions.
Select All/None and batch actions supported in grid.

workflows.name: Email Students
steps: User selects students via grid checkboxes.
User chooses email action from dropdown.
Email list compiled from selected student records.
Email action triggered, UI handles client-side scripting for BCC and message preparation.

workflows.name: Paging and Sorting
steps: Paging caption updated based on page size and record count.
Sorting applied by user on selected field, in ascending or descending order.

business_rules: Students who are waived cannot have CRC edited; their rows are disabled.
Graduated or inactive students have CRC actions disabled.
If 'blnReadOnly' is true, editing and actions are disabled for all users.
Email and key actions depend on access flags (AllowStudentAccess, StudentAccess, UserID).
Reactivate button enabled only for graduated or inactive students, and when not read-only.
Delete button enabled if student does not have PR record and not read-only.
Save All button hidden in header when editing single enrollment.
Actions can be blocked if session or required context parameters (cohort, term, course) not provided.
validations: Session (UserSession) must not be null; otherwise, action/event is canceled.
CRCStatusDate parsed and validated from UI input.
Dropdown values (CRCStatus) populated and verified against code list.
Client-side scripting used to maintain correct state of checkboxes and dirty fields for save actions.
calculations: Compiling student email list for communication (EmailList).
Compiling checkbox list for Select All/None client-side functionality.
Paging captions updated based on record count and page size.
Dirty state evaluation for each data row before save.
conditions: RowDisabled set if student graduated, inactive, or waived.
ScreenIsEditable false if read-only or row disabled.
ActionDisabled if row disabled, PR/WS exists.
Grid controls/buttons visibility toggled based on access and read-only flags.
system_behavior: On editing, updates CRC status, date, and notes in backend systems.
Grid refreshes on data changes, maintains paging/sorting/filter state.
Modal popups used for detailed editing of CRC status.
Email functionality driven by selected records and client-side scripting.
System responds to batch and single record actions.
dependencies: HSPnet.DataLayer for Enrollment and CRC status data.
HSPnet.UI for grid and modal popup controls.
User session context for permissions and filtering.
Codes repository for CRC status values.
exceptions: Actions canceled if session is null.
Database SQL errors during delete or update redirect to enrollment page.
UI hides buttons/controls based on permissions or action conditions.
